description.purpose: List the kinds of thing in the world.
description.returns: Each kind's identifier, one-line summary, how many live individuals it has with its specialisations, and how many of exactly its kind.
description.use_when: Exploring what the world contains: by default the kinds with individuals of their own; 'present' adds the general kinds those specialise, 'all' the world model's whole vocabulary; 'within' narrows any listing.
description.avoid: Finding the candidates of a kind you already know; search it with find_individuals instead.

within.description: A kind's identifier, or its plain name when no other kind shares it; only that kind and its specialisations are listed.

listing.description: Which kinds to list: 'instantiated', those with individuals of their own; 'present', those with individuals of their own or of a specialisation; 'all', every kind.
